episodes.summary: In this episode of M365.fm, Mirko Peters sits down with Microsoft MVP David Benaim to answer one of the biggest productivity questions in modern workplaces: Can Google Sheets really compete with Microsoft Excel? Instead of declaring a single winner, David explains why the answer depends on the task, the team, and the business requirements. The discussion explores where Google Sheets shines, including real-time collab
